many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]

    mks={(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==mc}
    bcs={(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==bar}
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def ray(j,d):
        sg=1 if d else -1; st=1 if d else H-2
        for i in range(st,H if d else -1,sg):
            if (i,j) in mks: break
            if g[i][j]!=bg: break
            out[i][j]=mc
    def rowray(i,d):
        sg=1 if d else -1; st=1 if d else W-2
        for j in range(st,W if d else -1,sg):
            if (i,j) in mks: break
            if g[i][j]!=bg: break
            out[i][j]=mc
    if any(i in (0,H-1) for i,j in bcs):   # horizontal bars
        ts={j for i,j in bcs if i==0}; bs={j for i,j in bcs if i==H-1}
        tlo,thi=min(ts),max(ts); blo,bhi=min(bs),max(bs)
        mkcols=sorted({j for i,j in mks})
        tj=max(ts,key=lambda c:max(abs(c-mc) for mr in mkcols))

def analyze(k):
    gi,go=G['Demo pair %d input'%k],G['Demo pair %d output'%k]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cc=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sc=[v for v,_ in cc.most_common()]
    barc=sc[1]; marc=[v for v in sc if v not in (bg,barc)][0]
    d=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if go[i][j]!=gi[i][j])
    bcells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==barc]
    mks=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==marc]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for cell in sorted(bcells):
        if cell in seen: continue
        st=[cell]; comp=[cell]
        while st:
            p=st.pop()
            if p in seen: continue
            seen.add(p); comp.append(p)
            i,j=p
            for a,b in ((i+1,j),(i-1,j),(i,j+1),(i,j-1)):
                if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and gi[a][b]==barc: st.append((a,b))
        comps.append(sorted(comp))
    print('pair',k,'bg',bg,'bar',barc,'mk',marc)
    for c in comps:
        rs=[i for i,_ in c]; cs=[j for _,j in c]
        print('   barcomp rows %d-%d cols %d-%d'%(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    print('   markers:',mks)
    # show diff pattern compactly
    for i in range(H):
        line=''
        for j in range(W):
            v=gi[i][j]
            if v==bg:
                line+= '.' if go[i][j]==bg else ('#')
            elif v==barc: line+='B'
            elif v==marc:
                line += 'M' if go[i][j]==marc else 'X'
            else: line+='*'
        print(f'{i:2d} {line}')
for k in [1,2]:analyze(k)

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])

    barc=sc[1]; marc=[v for v in sc if v!=bg and v!=barc][0]
    bcells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==barc]
    mks=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==marc]
    # components of bar cells
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for cell in bcells:
        if cell in seen: continue
        st=[cell]; comp=[]
        while st:
            p=st.pop()
            if p in seen: continue
            seen.add(p); comp.append(p)
            i,j=p
            for a,b in ((i+1,j),(i-1,j),(i,j+1),(i,j-1)):

        comps.append(comp)
    def bbox(c):
        if len({i for i,_ in c})==1: return min(j for _,j in c),max(j for _,j in c),min(i for i,_ in c)

    bs=[bbox(b) for b in comps]
    horiz=bool(min(j for _,j in comps[0])==min(j for _,j in comps[1]))  # assume consistent

    for mk in mks:

        kA,kB=[c[0] for c in cand]
        if kA==kB: continue
        SLo,SHi,_=bs[kA]
        other=1-kA
        oLo,oHi,O=bs[other]
        if horiz:
            # ray from marker bar down/up to other bar edge, stop before marker if marker between
            step=-1 if mi < O else 1
            ii=mi+step
            while 0<=ii<H and ii!=O and ii!=(O+(step-1)): pass
            lo,hi=min(mi,O),max(mi,O)
            # paint along col mj from mi towards other bar, exclusive of marker cell and exclusive of other bar row
            lo,hi=min(lo,hi-1) if hi-O==1 else (lo if lo>=mi else lo+1)
            for ii in range(lo,hi+1,step):
                if 0<=ii<H: res[ii][mj]=barc
            # mapped position into other bar's span
            if oHi-oLo:
                frac=(mj-SLo)/(SHi-SLo)
                p=oLo+int(frac*(oHi-oLo))
                for ii in range(min(O,(mi if mi<O else mi)),max(O,(mi if mi>O else mi))+1,step):
                    if ii!=O and 0<=ii<H: res[ii][p]=barc
        else:

            left,right=min(sLo,sHi),max(sLo,sHi)
            mInCol = sLo<=mjk<=sHi
            step=-1 if mjk < Ol else 1
            l,rk=min(mj,Ol),max(mj,Ol)
            for mm in range(l,rk+1,step):

            f2=(mjk-sLo)/(sHi-sLo)

            for kk in range(min(Ol,max(Ol)),max(Ol,min(Ol))+1,step):

    return res

    cc=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sc=[v for v,_ in cc.most_common()]
    barc=sc[1]; marc=[v for v in sc if v!=bg and v!=barc][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]==barc and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    p=st.pop()
                    if p in seen: continue
                    seen.add(p); comp.append(p)
                    a,b=p
                    for x,y in ((a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)):
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and gi[x][y]==barc: st.append((x,y))
                comps.append(comp)
    def span(cells,axis): return (min(t[axis] for t in cells),max(t[axis] for t in cells))
    B=sorted(comps,key=lambda c:(min(i for i,_ in c)))
    h_b = all(len({i for i,_ in c})==1 for c in B)
    res=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    barcells=set().union(*comps)
    for mk in [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==marc]:
        mr,mj=mk
        ax=1 if h_b else 0
        val=mj if h_b else mr
        fits=[k for k,c in enumerate(B) if span(c,ax)[0]<=val<=span(c,ax)[1]]
        if len(fits)!=1: continue
        kb=fits[0]; other=1-kb
        reflo,refhi=span(B[kb],ax)
        olo,o_hi=span(B[other],ax)
        f=(val-reflo)/(refhi-reflo)
        P=max(olo,min(o_hi,int(round(f*(o_hi-olo))+olo)))

        # own ray: perpendicular to bars, along marker line, from bar toward grid edge, stop before other bar

        rr=linecol + d
        while 0<=rr<H:
            if (rr,linecol) in barcells: break

            rr+=d

        if h_b:

                res[rr][P]=marc
        else:
            for cc in range(min(reflo,o_lo), max(refhi,o_hi)+1):
                if (mr,cc) in barcells or gi[mr][cc]!=bg: break
                res[mr][cc]=marc
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]==marc and res[i][j]==bg: res[i][j]=4
    return res

steps.input:
def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cc=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sc=[v for v,_ in cc.most_common()]
    barc=sc[1]; marc=[v for v in sc if v!=bg and v!=barc][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]==barc and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    p=st.pop()
                    if p in seen: continue
                    seen.add(p); comp.append(p)
                    a,b=p
                    for x,y in ((a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)):
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and gi[x][y]==barc: st.append((x,y))
                comps.append(comp)
    def span(cells,axis): return (min(t[axis] for t in cells),max(t[axis] for t in cells))
    B=sorted(comps,key=lambda c:(min(i for i,_ in c)))
    h_b = all(len({i for i,_ in c})==1 for c in B)
    res=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    barcells=set().union(*B)
    for mk in [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==marc]:
        mr,mj=mk
        ax=1 if h_b else 0
        val=mj if h_b else mr
        fits=[k for k,c in enumerate(B) if span(c,ax)[0]<=val<=span(c,ax)[1]]
        kb=fits[0]; other=1-kb
        reflo,refhi=span(B[kb],ax); olo,o_hi=span(B[other],ax)
        f=(val-reflo)/(refhi-reflo)
        P=max(olo,min(o_hi,int(round(f*(o_hi-olo))+olo)))
        step=1 if val>(reflo+refhi)/2 else -1
        linecol=mj if h_b else mr
        # own ray: both directions from marker until bar cell or grid edge; paint over anything except markers
        for sgn in (1,-1):
            rr=linecol+sgn
            while 0<=rr<H:
                if (rr,linecol) in barcells: break
                if gi[rr][linecol]==marc: res[rr][linecol]=4; break
                res[rr][linecol]=barc
                rr+=sgn
        # mapped ray: across rows between bars' perpendicular extents at col P
        if h_b:
            lo2,hi2=min(span(B[kb],1-ax)),max(span(B[kb],1-ax))
            for n in range(lo2,hi2+1):
                if (n,P) in barcells: break
                if gi[n][P]!=bg: break
                res[n][P]=barc
        else:
            lo2,hi2=min(span(B[kb],1-ax)),max(span(B[kb],1-ax))
            for n in range(lo2,hi2+1):
                if (mr,n) in barcells: break
                if gi[mr][n]!=bg: break
                res[mr][n]=barc
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]==marc and res[i][j]!=marc: res[i][j]=4
    return res
for k in range(1,9):
    r=solve(G['Demo pair %d input'%k]); go=G['Demo pair %d output'%k]
    d=[(i,j,go[i][j],r[i][j]) for i in range(len(go)) for j in range(len(go[0])) if r[i][j]!=go[i][j]]
    print(k, r==go, len(d), d[:6])

def analyze(k):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%k]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%k]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cc=Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_)
    bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def comps(c):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if gi[i][j]==c and (i,j) not in seen:
                    st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                    while st:
                        p=st.pop()
                        if p in seen: continue
                        seen.add(p); comp.append(p)
                        for x,y in ((p[0]+1,p[1]),(p[0]-1,p[1]),(p[0],p[1]+1),(p[0],p[1]-1)):
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and gi[x][y]==c: st.append((x,y))
                    out.append(comp)
        return out
    others=sorted(set(cc)-{bg})
    bars=others[0] if len(comps(others[0]))==2 else None
    # determine bar color: color with exactly 2 connected components
    bc=None
    for c in others:
        cs=comps(c)
        if len(cs)==2: bc=c; break
    mkcs=[c for c in others if c!=bc]
    mks=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j] in mkcs]
    bcells={(i,j) for s in comps(bc) for i,j in s}
    P=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==bg and go[i][j]==bc]
    print('pair',k,'bg',bg,'bar',bc,'mkcs',mkcs,'nmarks',len(mks),'npaint',len(P))
    print('markers',sorted(mks))
    print('bars segs:',[(min(s),max(s)) for s in comps(bc)])
    # minimal bounding info of painted cells per row/col
    rowsP=Counter(i for i,j in P); colsP=Counter(j for i,j in P)
    print('paint rows:',sorted(rowsP.items()))
    print('paint cols:',sorted(colsP.items()))
analyze(8)

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cc=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_)
    bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in sorted(set(cc)-{bg}) if cc[c]<H*W//2]
    mc=min(others,key=lambda c:cc[c]); bc=[c for c in others if c!=mc][0]
    def comps(c):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if gi[i][j]==c and (i,j) not in seen:
                    st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                    while st:
                        p=st.pop()
                        if p in seen: continue
                        seen.add(p); comp.append(p)
                        for x,y in ((p[0]+1,p[1]),(p[0]-1,p[1]),(p[0],p[1]+1),(p[0],p[1]-1)):
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and gi[x][y]==c: st.append((x,y))
                    out.append(comp)
        return out
    bs=comps(bc)
    vert=all(len({j for i,j in s})==1 for s in bs)
    segs=sorted(bs,key=lambda s:min(i for i,j in s)) if vert else sorted(bs,key=lambda s:min(j for i,j in s))
    A,B=segs[0],segs[-1]
    if vert:
        spanA=(min(i for i,j in A),max(i for i,j in A)); spanB=(min(i for i,j in B),max(i for i,j in B))
        mks=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mc)

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cc=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_)
    bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in sorted(set(cc)-{bg}) if cc[c]<H*W//2]
    mc=min(others,key=lambda c:cc[c]); bc=max(others,key=lambda c:cc[c])
    def comps(c):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if gi[i][j]==c and (i,j) not in seen:
                    st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                    while st:
                        p=st.pop()
                        if p in seen: continue
                        seen.add(p); comp.append(p)
                        for x,y in ((p[0]+1,p[1]),(p[0]-1,p[1]),(p[0],p[1]+1),(p[0],p[1]-1)):
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and gi[x][y]==c: st.append((x,y))
                    out.append(comp)
        return out
    bs=comps(bc)
    vert=all(len({j for i,j in s})==1 for s in bs)
    segs=sorted(bs,key=lambda s:min(i for i,j in s) if vert else min(j for i,j in s))
    A,B=segs[0],segs[-1]
    sa=(min(i for i,j in A),max(i for i,j in A)) if vert else (min(j for i,j in A),max(j for i,j in A))
    sb=(min(i for i,j in B),max(i for i,j in B)) if vert else (min(j for i,j in B),max(j for i,j in B))
    mks=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mc)
    bcells={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==bc}
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    for mi,mj in mks:
        src = mi if vert else mj
        tgt=sb if sa[0]<=src<=sa[1] else sa
        d=1 if tgt==sb else -1
        k_=src
        while True:
            nk=k_+d
            if not(0<=nk<H if vert else 0<=nk<W): break
            if vert:
                p=(nk,mj)
                if p in bcells or out[nk][mj]!=bg: break
                out[nk][mj]=mc; k_=nk
            else:
                p=(mi,nk)
                if p in bcells or out[mi][nk]!=bg: break
                out[mi][nk]=mc; k_=nk
        o,t=(sa,sb) if src in sa else (sb,sa)
        idx=src-o[0]; nb=t[0]+idx
        if vert:
            lo,hi=sa[0],sb[1]
            for ni in range(lo,hi+1):
                p=(ni,nb)
                if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nb<W and p not in bcells and out[ni][nb]==bg: out[ni][nb]=mc
        else:
            lo,hi=sa[0],sb[1]
            for nj in range(lo,hi+1):
                p=(nb,nj)
                if 0<=nb<H and 0<=nj<W and p not in bcells and out[nb][nj]==bg: out[nb][nj]=mc
        out[mi][mj]=4
    return out
res={k:solve(G['Demo pair %d input'%k])==G['Demo pair %d output'%k] for k in [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]}
print(res)

def paint_rule(gi, opts):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cc=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_)
    bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rest=[c for c in sorted(set(cc)-{bg}) if cc[c]<H*W//2]
    mc=min(rest,key=lambda c:cc[c]); bc=max(rest,key=lambda c:cc[c])
    def comps(c):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if gi[i][j]==c and (i,j) not in seen:
                    st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                    while st:
                        p=st.pop()
                        if p in seen: continue
                        seen.add(p); comp.append(p)
                        for x,y in ((p[0]+1,p[1]),(p[0]-1,p[1]),(p[0],p[1]+1),(p[0],p[1]-1)):
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and gi[x][y]==c: st.append((x,y))
                    out.append(comp)
        return out
    bs=comps(bc)
    vert=all(len({j for i,j in s})==1 for s in bs)
    segs=sorted(bs,key=lambda s:min(i for i,j in s) if vert else min(j for i,j in s))
    A,B=segs[0],segs[-1]
    def span(s):
        return (min(i for i,j in s),max(i for i,j in s)) if vert else (min(j for i,j in s),max(j for i,j in s))
    sa,sb=span(A),span(B)
    mks=sorted((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mc)
    bcells={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==bc}
    # occupied originally (bars + markers)
    occ=bcells|set(mks)
    out=[[gi[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    def empty(p):
        return 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and out[p[0]][p[1]]==bg
    def convert_marker():
        for mi,mj in mks: out[mi][mj]=4
    for mi,mj in mks:
        src=mi if vert else mj
        # direction: toward the bar whose span contains src (tie -> both)
        cand=[d for d,(a,b) in enumerate([(sa,sb),(sb,sa)]) if opts['tgt'](a,b,src)]
        if not cand: cand=[0,1]
        orders=opts['order']
        for d in cand:
            tgt,a_,b_=[(None,None,sa)][0] if False else (None,None,sa)
            t,b=a_,b_
            dsgn=1 if b[0]>a_[0] else -1
            for offs in orders:
                k_=src
                while True:
                    n=k_+dsgn
                    p=(n if vert else mi, nj:= (mj if vert else n)) if False else ((n if vert else None),(nj if not vert else None))[0]
                    # simpler: build p directly
                    p = ((n if vert else mi),(mj if vert else n))
                    if not empty(p): break
                    if out[p[0]][p[1]]==mc: break
                    if out[p[0]][p[1]]==4 and opts['cross_stop']: break
                    out[p[0]][p[1]]=mc; k_=n
    convert_marker()
    return out

def solve(gi):

    cc=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_)

        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if gi[i][j]==c and (i,j) not in seen:
                    st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                    while st:
                        q=st.pop()
                        if q in seen: continue
                        seen.add(q); comp.append(q)
                        for x,y in ((q[0]+1,q[1]),(q[0]-1,q[1]),(q[0],q[1]+1),(q[0],q[1]-1)):

                    out.append(comp)
        return out

    bc=None; mkc=None

    def span(s):

    S=[span(s) for s in segs]

        perp = mj if vert else mi

        if not cand: continue
        ds=[S[i][0]-mi if vert else S[i][0]-mj for i in cand]
        tgt = max(cand,key=lambda i:ds[i]) if ds[0]<0 else min(cand,key=lambda i:ds[i])
        tgt=S[tgt]; tlow,thigh=tgt
        dr,dc=(1 if mi<tlow else -1 if mi>thigh else 0, 0) if vert else (0,1 if mj<tlow else -1 if mj>thigh else 0)
        for i,j in [(mi+dr,k) if vert else (k,mj+dc) for k in range(mi,H) if vert else range(mj,W)]:
            if not(0<=i<H and 0<=j<W): break
            if out[i][j]!=bg: break
            out[i][j]=mkc
        # mapped ray: other segment
        o=[i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(S) if i!=tgt][0]
        oS=S[o]
        idx = perp - S[tgt][0]
        oc = (oS[0]+((idx)% (oS[1]-oS[0]+1))) if vert else (oS[0]+((idx%(oS[1]-oS[0]+1)))))
        step = 1 if tgt[0]<oS[0] else -1 if vert else (1 if S[tgt][0]<oS[0] else -1)
        # ray extends away from containing segment toward/through, filling gap between segments
        for k in range(H):
            i,j=(k,oc) if vert else (oc,k)
            if not(0<=i<H and 0<=j<W) or out[i][j]!=bg: break
            out[i][j]=mkc
        out[mi][mj]=4
    return out

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cc=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_)
    bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in sorted(cc) if c!=bg]
    def comps(c):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if gi[i][j]==c and (i,j) not in seen:
                    st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                    while st:
                        q=st.pop()
                        if q in seen: continue
                        seen.add(q); comp.append(q)
                        for x,y in ((q[0]+1,q[1]),(q[0]-1,q[1]),(q[0],q[1]+1),(q[0],q[1]-1)):
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and gi[x][y]==c: st.append((x,y))
                    out.append(comp)
        return out
    barc=None; mkc=None
    for c in others:
        cs=comps(c)
        if len(cs)==2 and (all(len({p[0] for p in s})==1 for s in cs) or all(len({p[1] for p in s})==1 for s in cs)):
            barc=c; break
    mkc=[c for c in others if c!=barc][0]
    mks=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mkc]
    cs=comps(barc)
    if all(len({p[0] for p in s})==1 for s in cs):
        horiz=True
        segs=sorted([(min(j for _,j in s),max(j for _,j in s)) for s in cs])
    else:
        horiz=False
        segs=sorted([(min(i for i,_ in s),max(i for i,_ in s)) for s in cs])
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    for mi,mj in mks:
        # own ray: along marker's axis (perpendicular to bars), choose segment containing proj coord; tie -> farther segment
        proj = mj if horiz else mi
        cand=[idx for idx,(a,b) in enumerate(segs) if a<=proj<=b]
        tgt=None
        if len(cand)==1: tgt=cand[0]
        elif len(cand)>=2:
            d1=segs[cand[0]][0]; d2=segs[cand[-1]][1]
            tgt=cand[0] if abs(d1-mj if horiz else d1-mi)<abs(d2-mj if horiz else d2-mi) else cand[-1]
        else:
            tgt=len(segs)//2 if len(segs)>1 else None
        ts=segs[tgt]
        lo,hi=ts
        k = proj - hi if tgt!=0 and tgt==len(segs)-1 else proj+lo if True else None
        # determine direction away from chosen segment, painting cells adjacent onward
        step=(1,0) if horiz else (0,1)
        # ray starts from the cell adjacent to the segment end nearest to marker, extending until blocked by another segment
        src = (mi+step[0] if False else 0, 0)
        if horiz:
            left=lo; right=hi
            if mj < (lo+hi)/2: src=(mj,left-1) if left>0 else None; dr=left-1
            else: src=(mj,right+1); dr=right+1
            while 0<=src[0]<H:
                if out[src[0]][src[1]]==bg: out[src[0]][src[1]]=mkc
                src=(src[0]+1,src[1])
        else:
            down=hi; up=lo
            if mi > (up+down)/2: src=(down+1,mj); dr=down+1
            else: src=(up-1,mj); dr=up-1
            while 0<=src[0]<H:
                if out[src[0]][src[1]]==bg: out[src[0]][src[1]]=mkc
                src=(src[0]+1,mj)
        out[mi][mj]=4
    return out
for k in range(1,9):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%k]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%k]
    print(k, solve(gi)==go)

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cc=collections.Counter(v for r_ in gi for v in r_)
    bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def comps(c):
        seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if gi[i][j]==c and not seen[i][j]:
                    st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cs=[]
                    while st:
                        x,y=st.pop(); cs.append((x,y))
                        for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                            if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and gi[nx][ny]==c and not seen[nx][ny]:
                                seen[nx][ny]=True; st.append((nx,ny))
                    out.append(sorted(cs))
        return out
    bcs=[]
    for c in cc:
        if c==bg: continue
        s=comps(c)
        if len(s)==2 and all(is_segment(x) for x in s): bcs.append((c,s)); break
    bc,segs=bcs[0]
    mk=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=bg and gi[i][j]!=bc]
    res=[row[:] for row in gi]
    if is_segment(segs[0]): horizontal=True
    else: horizontal=False
    segs_sorted=sorted(segs,key=lambda s:(min(p[0] for p in s),min(p[1] for p in s)))
    top,bot=segs_sorted[0],segs_sorted[1]
    for (i,j) in sorted(mk):
        mc=gi[i][j]
        # index along bar axis within source bar
        src=top if is_row(i,top) or is_col(j,top) else bot
        if horizontal:
            idx=sum(1 for (r_,y_) in src if r_==i and y_<j)-1
        else:
            idx=sum(1 for (r_,y_) in src if y_==j and r_<i)-1
        tgt_idx = -idx-1  # reflected position on other bar
        if horizontal:
            t=tgt[0][1]+tgt_idx
            for y in range(W):
                if gi[top[0]][y]==bg: res[top[0]][y]=mc
            dy=-1 if top[0]<i else 1
            x=i+dy
            while 0<=x<H and gi[x][j]==bg: res[x][j]=mc; x+=dy
        else:
            t=tgt[0][0]+tgt_idx
            for x in range(H):
                if gi[x][bot[0][1]]==bg: res[x][bot[0][1]]=mc
            dy=-1 if bot[0][1]<j else 1
            x=j+dy
            while 0<=x<W and gi[i][x]==bg: res[i][x]=mc; x+=dy
        res[i][j]=4
    return res
for n in [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]:
    print(n, solve(G['Demo pair %d input'%n])==G['Demo pair %d output'%n])
